workgroup.description: NetBIOS workgroup or domain name (must match realm in uppercase)

realm.description: Kerberos realm name (fully qualified domain name, uppercase)

netbios_name.description: NetBIOS name of this domain controller

server_services.description: List of core services to start (required for AD DC operation)

log_level.description: Samba log verbosity level (0=none, 10=debug). 2–3 is typical for production

log_file.description: Log file path (supports %m macro for per-machine logs)

max_log_size.description: Maximum size (in KiB) per log file before rotation

dns_forwarder.description: DNS forwarder for Samba’s internal DNS server (e.g., upstream DNS server)

dcerpc_endpoint_servers.description: DCERPC endpoints to expose; avoid exposing unnecessary ones for security

dns_backend.description: DNS backend type. Use 'SAMBA_INTERNAL' for built-in DNS; 'BIND9_DLZ' for BIND9 integration

min_password_length.description: Minimum number of characters required for new passwords (recommend ≥12)

password_history.description: Number of previous passwords to remember (to prevent reuse)

logon_script.description: Default logon script name (placed in sysvol)

logon_drive.description: Drive letter for home/profile share (e.g., 'H:' or '' for none)

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections allowed

socket_options.description: TCP/IP socket options for performance tuning

aio_max_threads.description: Max threads for asynchronous I/O (adjust based on I/O workload)

server_signing.description: SMB signing requirement for incoming connections ('auto', 'disabled', 'required')

client_signing.description: SMB signing requirement for outgoing client connections

server_min_protocol.description: Minimum SMB protocol version supported (avoid NT1 for security)

client_min_protocol.description: Minimum SMB protocol version clients may use

ntlm_auth.description: Allow NTLM authentication (disabled recommended; legacy clients only)

netlogon_path.description: Filesystem path to NETLOGON share (auto-generated from realm)

shares.description: List of custom shares (e.g., for data, departments)

path.description: Absolute filesystem path for the share

read_only.description: If true, users can only read; if false, write access granted

browsable.description: Whether the share appears in directory listings

guest_ok.description: Allow guest access (not recommended for AD DC shares)

write_list.description: List of users/groups (e.g., 'DOMAIN\user1', '@DOMAIN\group') allowed to write

valid_users.description: List of users/groups allowed access (if empty, uses default ACL)

force_user.description: Username to force for all file operations (e.g., 'admin' or 'DOMAIN\admin')

force_group.description: Group to force for new files/dirs
